title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
description: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

title: Broad access through consistent standards
description: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
description: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
description: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
description: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

title: Cloudflare links vulnerability discovery to defense with OpenAI
description: Cloudflare uses OpenAI Daybreak to investigate vulnerabilities and propose fixes for review. Its developers use Codex to build faster and improve code quality.

title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
description: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

title: Democratic governance of frontier AI, part II: Empowering cyber defenders
description: OpenAI outlines a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders with frontier AI, stronger safeguards, modernized cybersecurity, and more resilient public institutions.

title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
description: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
description: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.

title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
description: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
description: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
description: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
description: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
description: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.
